PasswordResetMail.subject: Reset your password
PasswordResetMail.asked: Someone asked to reset the password of your account at {host}.

PasswordResetMail.open.one: Open this link within {count} minute to choose a new password.
PasswordResetMail.open.other: Open this link within {count} minutes to choose a new password.

PasswordResetMail.once: The link works once, and using it signs you out everywhere.
PasswordResetMail.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this mail: your password stays as it is.
SignInLinkMail.subject: Your sign-in link for {host}
SignInLinkMail.asked: Someone asked to sign in to {host} with this address on {when}.

SignInLinkMail.open.one: Open this link within {count} minute to sign in. If no account uses this address yet, it creates one.
SignInLinkMail.open.other: Open this link within {count} minutes to sign in. If no account uses this address yet, it creates one.

SignInLinkMail.once: The link works once. Opening it shows a page with a Continue button: nothing happens until you press it.
SignInLinkMail.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this mail. Nobody can sign in without the link.
EmailCodeMail.subject: Your code to confirm your e-mail address
EmailCodeMail.asked: Enter this code at {host} to confirm this is your e-mail address.
EmailCodeMail.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this mail: nothing changes.
InvitationMail.subject: Invitation to join "{group}"
InvitationMail.invited: {who} invited you to join "{group}" at {host}, with the role {role}.
InvitationMail.invitedNoName: You are invited to join "{group}" at {host}, with the role {role}.

InvitationMail.open.one: Open this link within {count} day to accept or decline.
InvitationMail.open.other: Open this link within {count} days to accept or decline.

InvitationMail.account: The invitation is for this e-mail address: accept it with the account that uses it.
InvitationMail.ignore: If you do not want to join, ignore this mail.
AccountDeletionMail.subject: Your account will be deleted on {date}
AccountDeletionMail.asked: Your account at {host} will be deleted for good on {date}, as you asked.
AccountDeletionMail.keep: Changed your mind? Sign in before then and your account is restored.
AccountDeletionMail.notYou: If you did not ask for this, sign in now to keep your account, then change your password.
AccountRestoredMail.subject: Your account was restored
AccountRestoredMail.restored: Your account at {host} was restored by a sign-in, so it will no longer be deleted.
AccountRestoredMail.notYou: If this wasn't you, sign in, delete your account again and change your password.
DataExportReadyMail.subject: Your data is ready
DataExportReadyMail.ready: Download it from your profile until {date}.
DataExportReadyMail.notYou: If you did not ask for this, change your password and sign out of your other devices.
SignInMethodMail.passkeyAddedSubject: A passkey was added to your account
SignInMethodMail.passkeyAdded: A passkey was added to your account at {host} on {when}. It can now sign in to it.
SignInMethodMail.passkeyAddedNotYou: If this wasn't you, remove the passkey on your profile page and change your password.
SignInMethodMail.passkeyRemovedSubject: A passkey was removed from your account
SignInMethodMail.passkeyRemoved: A passkey was removed from your account at {host} on {when}. It no longer signs in to it.
SignInMethodMail.passkeyRemovedNotYou: If this wasn't you, sign in, change your password and add your passkey again.
SignInMethodMail.linked: {provider} was linked to your account at {host} on {when}. It can now sign in to it.
SignInMethodMail.linkedNotYou: If this wasn't you, unlink {provider} on your profile page and change your password.
SignInMethodMail.unlinked: {provider} was unlinked from your account at {host} on {when}. It no longer signs in to it.
SignInMethodMail.unlinkedNotYou: If this wasn't you, sign in, change your password and link {provider} again.
ApiTokenMail.subject: An API token was created
ApiTokenMail.created: An API token named "{name}" was created for your account at {host}.
ApiTokenMail.readUntil: It can read the group "{group}" and expires on {date}.
ApiTokenMail.readForever: It can read the group "{group}" and never expires.
ApiTokenMail.writeUntil: It can read and write the group "{group}" and expires on {date}.
ApiTokenMail.writeForever: It can read and write the group "{group}" and never expires.
ApiTokenMail.notYou: If this wasn't you, revoke the token on your profile page and change your password, which revokes every API token.
BillingNoticeMail.trialWithCard: The subscription then starts and is charged. To stop it, cancel it before then from the group's page.
BillingNoticeMail.trialWithoutCard: Add a card from the group's page before then to keep the plan: the subscription then starts and is charged. Without a card, the group moves to the free plan.
BillingNoticeMail.paymentWhat: A payment for the {plan} plan of "{group}" failed.
BillingNoticeMail.paymentKept: The plan is kept until {date} while the payment is retried. Update the card from the group's page to keep it.
BillingNoticeMail.paymentFree: The group is now on the free plan. Update the card from the group's page to get the plan back.
BillingNoticeMail.planWhat: The {plan} plan of "{group}" was cancelled and ends on {date}; the group then moves to the free plan.
BillingNoticeMail.planNext: Changed your mind? Renew it from the group's page before then.
SubscriberConfirmMail.subject: Confirm your subscription to {host}
SubscriberConfirmMail.asked: Someone asked to send news from {host} to this address.
SubscriberConfirmMail.within: Confirm within three days to start getting it.
SubscriberConfirmMail.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this mail: nothing is sent to you.
SubscriberWelcomeMail.subject: You are subscribed to {host}
SubscriberWelcomeMail.subscribed: You are subscribed to news from {host}.
SubscriberWelcomeMail.reason: You get this mail because you subscribed at {host}.
SubscriberIssue.reason: You get this mail because you subscribed at {host}.
